item.title: Mechanochemical-induced structural evolution governs lithium extraction kinetics in LiMn₂O₄ ion sieves
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Mechanochemical milling is shown to govern lithium extraction kinetics in LiMn₂O₄ ion sieves through mechanochemically induced structural evolution—a mechanism previously poorly understood. This links processing-induced structural changes to DLE performance, offering a design lever for tuning lithium extraction kinetics and advancing efficient direct lithium extraction sorbents.
🏷 lithium ion sieve · LiMn2O4 · direct lithium extraction · mechanochemical milling · extraction kinetics

item.title: Multiphase Inorganic-Rich Interphases with Integrated Li-Ion Capture-Transport Ability for High-Rate Lithium Metal Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله یک SEI چندفازی غنی از ترکیبات معدنی با قابلیت یکپارچه جذب-انتقال Li+ ایجاد می‌کند که انتقال سریع یون و سرکوب دندریت را در باتری‌های لیتیوم فلزی ممکن می‌سازد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a multiphase inorganic-rich SEI (Li3P, LiAl5O8, Li3PO4, Li2Al) formed in situ from an ADP interlayer, enabling an integrated Li+ capture-transport mechanism via high affinity, facile desolvation, and low-barrier migration. Its 17.14 GPa modulus suppresses dendrites. Significance: 1000 h at 4 mA cm–2, 80% retention after 250 cycles in high-loading full cells, and 90% after 500 cycles in pouch cells.
🏷 lithium metal battery · solid-electrolyte interphase · Li-ion transport · inorganic-rich SEI · dendrite suppression

Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using unconventional Li6MnO4 and MnF2 precursors to reshape the solid-state reaction pathway, suppressing less reactive intermediates and enabling bulk fluorination of Mn-rich DRX cathodes at lower temperature. This prevents lithium/fluorine volatilization, retains high fluorine content and lithium excess for 3D percolation, and yields improved electrochemical performance versus conventional precursors—advancing cobalt/nickel-free high-capacity cathodes.
🏷 Mn-rich DRX cathode · bulk fluorination · solid-state reaction · precursor engineering · Li-ion battery

item.title: Beyond boundary lines: predicting P2/O3 phase fractions in layered Na-ion cathodes
item.description:

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in using machine learning with composition and synthesis descriptors to quantitatively predict P2/O3 phase fractions in Na-ion layered cathodes, moving beyond qualitative phase control. Its significance is providing actionable design guidance for engineering biphasic P2/O3 materials with optimized performance.
🏷 Na-ion cathode · P2/O3 biphasic · machine learning · phase fraction prediction · layered oxide

Journal of Materials Chemistry A | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in interfacial phosphide-phosphate (NiCoP-POₓ/carbon) heterostructure engineering, which enhances charge transfer and active sites for efficient piezoelectric-driven self-charging asymmetric supercapacitors. Its significance is integrating energy harvesting and storage into one wearable-compatible device, offering a sustainable, compact power solution for portable electronics.
